name: oxytocin
notes: Oxytocin: Cys1-Cys6 disulfide (R3-R3); C-terminal amide as the am cap monomer.

name: octreotide
notes: Octreotide (Sandostatin): Cys2-Cys7; D-Phe/D-Trp as dF/dW; C-terminal threoninol Thr-ol is bracketed because its name has a dash.

name: eptifibatide_like
notes: Eptifibatide-like: Mpr1-Cys7 disulfide. The library has no 3-mercaptopropionyl with an R3, so Mpa ((S)-2-mercaptopropanoic acid; R2+R3, no R1) stands in; hArg = homoarginine; amide as am.

name: linaclotide
notes: Linaclotide (Linzess), 14 aa: 1-6, 2-10, 5-13. Two adjacent Cys pairs (1-2, 5-6) each bridged to different partners; all three bonds overlap or cross.

name: ziconotide
notes: Ziconotide (Prialt, omega-conotoxin MVIIA), 25 aa + amide: 1-16, 8-20, 15-25 (C1-C4, C2-C5, C3-C6). Cys15/Cys16 adjacent with different partners.

name: chlorotoxin
notes: Chlorotoxin (scorpion toxin, the peptide of tozuleristide), 36 aa + C-terminal amide: 2-19, 5-28, 16-33, 20-35; Cys19/Cys20 adjacent. Bond ids 10-13 exercise the parser's two-digit ids.

name: crambin
notes: Crambin (46 aa plant protein, PDB 1CRN): 3-40 contains 4-32 contains 16-26 (fully nested); 3-40 spans 37 residues; Cys3/Cys4 adjacent.

name: mecasermin
notes: Mecasermin (Increlex, rhIGF-1), 70 aa: 6-48 and 18-61 span 42/43 residues and cross; short 47-52 starts next to Cys48 (bridged to Cys6).

name: vasopressin
notes: Arginine vasopressin, 9 aa + C-terminal amide: Cys1-Cys6.

name: desmopressin_like
notes: Desmopressin-like (dDAVP): deamino-Cys1 to Cys6, D-Arg8 as dR. Mpa ((S)-2-mercaptopropanoic acid) stands in for the 3-mercaptopropanoyl N-cap, which the default library lacks.

name: terlipressin
notes: Terlipressin: triglycyl-lysine vasopressin, the Cys4-Cys9 ring after three N-terminal Gly.

name: felypressin
notes: [Phe2, Lys8]-vasopressin: Cys1-Cys6.

name: atosiban_like
notes: Atosiban-like: D-Tyr(Et)2 and Orn8; the N-cap thiol to Cys6. Mpa stands in for 3-mercaptopropanoyl.

name: lanreotide
notes: Lanreotide (Somatuline): D-2-naphthylalanine N-terminus, D-Trp4, Cys2-Cys7.

name: vapreotide
notes: Vapreotide: D-Phe1, D-Trp4, Cys2-Cys7.

name: somatostatin-14
notes: Somatostatin-14: Cys3-Cys14, the ring the octreotide family shortens.

name: setmelanotide
notes: Setmelanotide (Imcivree): Ac-Arg, then the Cys2-Cys8 ring with D-Ala and D-Phe.

name: compstatin_Cp40
notes: Compstatin Cp40: D-Tyr1, 1-methyl-Trp (Trp_Me), sarcosine (meG) and N-methyl-Ile (meI); Cys3-Cys13.

name: DPDPE
notes: [D-Pen2, D-Pen5]-enkephalin: a disulfide between two D-penicillamines (bracketed, the name has a dash).

name: plecanatide
notes: Plecanatide (Trulance), 16 aa: Cys4-Cys12 and Cys7-Cys15 cross.

name: guanylin
notes: Human guanylin, 15 aa: Cys4-Cys12 and Cys7-Cys15 cross.

name: alpha-conotoxin_GI
notes: Alpha-conotoxin GI, 13 aa + amide: Cys2-Cys7 and Cys3-Cys13 (adjacent Cys with different partners).

name: alpha-conotoxin_MII
notes: Alpha-conotoxin MII, 16 aa + amide: Cys2-Cys8 and Cys3-Cys16.

name: alpha-conotoxin_ImI
notes: Alpha-conotoxin ImI, 12 aa + amide: Cys2-Cys8 and Cys3-Cys12.

name: mu-conotoxin_GIIIA
notes: Mu-conotoxin GIIIA, 22 aa + amide with three hydroxyprolines (Hyp): Cys3-Cys15, Cys4-Cys20, Cys10-Cys21.

name: endothelin-1
notes: Endothelin-1, 21 aa: Cys1-Cys15 contains Cys3-Cys11.

name: apamin
notes: Apamin (bee venom), 18 aa + amide: Cys1-Cys11 and Cys3-Cys15 cross.

name: calcitonin_salmon
notes: Salmon calcitonin, 32 aa + amide: a small Cys1-Cys7 ring at the start of a long tail.

name: pramlintide
notes: Pramlintide (Symlin): amylin with Pro25, Pro28, Pro29; Cys2-Cys7.

name: nesiritide
notes: Nesiritide (BNP-32): one 17-residue ring, Cys10-Cys26.

name: EETI-II
notes: EETI-II (squash trypsin inhibitor, a knottin), 28 aa: Cys2-Cys19, Cys9-Cys21, Cys15-Cys27.

name: hepcidin-25
notes: Hepcidin-25, 25 aa: eight Cys in 18 residues, four bonds: Cys7-Cys23, Cys10-Cys13, Cys11-Cys19, Cys14-Cys22.

name: kalata_B1
notes: Kalata B1 (prototypic cyclotide), cyclic 29 aa: cystine knot 5-19, 9-21, 14-26 (I-IV, II-V, III-VI); backbone closed Gly1 R1 to Asn29 R2.

name: RTD-1
notes: RTD-1 (rhesus theta-defensin 1), cyclic 18 aa: three parallel disulfides 3-16, 5-14, 7-12 that nest in the linear display; head-to-tail Gly1-Arg18.

name: cyclosporin_like
notes: Cyclosporin A-like cyclic undecapeptide: 7 N-methyl residues (meG = Sar, meL, meV), D-Ala as dA; MeBmt is not in the library, Bmt_E (same side chain, no N-methyl) stands in.

name: SFTI-1_rotated
notes: SFTI-1 (sunflower trypsin inhibitor 1, cyclo-GRCTKSIPPICFPD) written from Cys3 so the first monomer carries two bonds: the Cys3-Cys11 disulfide (R3) and the ring closure (R1 to Arg2 R2).

name: cilengitide
notes: Cilengitide, cyclo(RGDf-NMeVal): D-Phe as dF, N-methyl-Val as meV; Arg R1 to meV R2.

name: cRGDfK
notes: cyclo(RGDfK), the integrin ligand of RGD conjugates.

name: gramicidin_S
notes: Gramicidin S, cyclo(Val-Orn-Leu-D-Phe-Pro)2: ornithine and D-Phe twice.

name: tyrocidine_A
notes: Tyrocidine A, cyclic decapeptide: two D-Phe and an ornithine.

name: pasireotide_like
notes: Pasireotide-like cyclic hexapeptide: phenylglycine, D-Trp, Tyr(Bzl). Plain Hyp stands in for the Hyp(2-aminoethylcarbamoyl) of the drug.

name: stapled_helix
notes: Synthetic double-stapled helix: i,i+4 lactam Glu4-Lys8 and i,i+7 lactam Lys7-Asp14 (positions count the ac cap as 1). Hydrocarbon staples (S5/R8) have no monomers in the default library, so side-chain lactams (R3-R3) stand in; the two staples cross and Lys7/Lys8 are adjacent.

name: microcin_J25
notes: Microcin J25 (lasso peptide), 21 aa: macrolactam from the Gly1 alpha-amine (R1) to the Glu8 side chain (R3); the threaded C-terminal tail is 3D only.

name: polymyxin_B_like
notes: Polymyxin B-like: heptapeptide ring from the Dab4 side chain (R3; chain position 5 after the acyl) to the C-terminal Thr10 (R2), tripeptide tail; Bua (butanoyl) stands in for 6-methyloctanoyl.

name: bremelanotide
notes: Bremelanotide (Vyleesi): norleucine, then a lactam from the Asp side-chain carboxyl to the Lys side-chain amine (R3-R3); free C-terminal acid.

name: melanotan_II
notes: Melanotan II: as bremelanotide with a C-terminal amide.

name: colistin_like
notes: Colistin-like (polymyxin E1): lariat from the Dab4 side-chain amine to the C-terminal Thr; five Dab, D-Leu. Bua (butanoyl) stands in for 6-methyloctanoyl.

name: insulin_human
notes: Human insulin, A chain 21 + B chain 30 = 51 residues: A6-A11 intrachain, A7-B7 and A20-B19 interchain.

name: insulin_degludec_like
notes: Insulin degludec-like: desB30 insulin, LysB29 N-epsilon acylated through gamma-Glu (third chain). gGlu R2 (gamma-carbonyl) bonds Lys R3; Bua (butanoyl) stands in for hexadecanedioyl (no long fatty acyl monomer in the default library).

name: insulin_glargine
notes: Insulin glargine (Lantus): Gly at A21 and two Arg after B30; disulfides as human insulin.

name: insulin_lispro
notes: Insulin lispro (Humalog): Lys-Pro at B28-B29 swapped.

name: insulin_aspart
notes: Insulin aspart (NovoLog): Asp at B28.

name: insulin_glulisine
notes: Insulin glulisine (Apidra): Lys at B3, Glu at B29.

name: insulin_detemir_like
notes: Insulin detemir-like: desB30, LysB29 N-epsilon acylated by a one-monomer third chain; Bua (butanoyl) stands in for myristoyl.

name: etelcalcetide
notes: Etelcalcetide (Parsabiv): seven D-amino acids; the D-Cys1 thiol is bonded to a free L-Cys, a one-monomer second chain.

name: glutathione_disulfide
notes: Glutathione disulfide (GSSG): two gamma-Glu-Cys-Gly chains; gGlu bonds through its gamma-carbonyl (R2).

name: E-cRGDfK2_dimer
notes: E[c(RGDfK)]2, the dimeric RGD of integrin imaging: a Glu acylates both Lys side chains, with its alpha-carbonyl (R2) and its side-chain carboxyl (R3); each Lys also closes its ring (R2 to Arg R1).

name: semaglutide_like
notes: Semaglutide-like: Lys26 (position 20) N-epsilon carries OEG-OEG-gammaGlu-C18 diacid, written as a second chain whose last monomer bonds Lys R3; bAla stands in for OEG (AEEA) and Bua for the C18 diacid (not in the default library).

name: liraglutide_like
notes: Liraglutide-like: GLP-1(7-37) with Arg34; Lys26 N-epsilon carries gamma-Glu (gGlu R2 to Lys R3) and a fatty acyl; Bua (butanoyl) stands in for palmitoyl.

name: tirzepatide_like
notes: Tirzepatide-like: two Aib; Lys20 carries gamma-Glu-2xAEEA-C20 diacid, with bAla standing in for AEEA and Bua for the diacid.

name: MAP4_NANP
notes: Multiple antigenic peptide: four copies of the malaria CS repeat (NANP)2 on a Lys-Lys2 core with a bAla anchor. Each branching Lys carries one copy on its alpha-amine (backbone) and one on its epsilon-amine (R3); the second Lys hangs on the core Lys side chain by its carbonyl (R2).

name: trivalent_cRGDfK_THA
notes: Trivalent c(RGDfK) (synthetic, after RGD multimers for integrin imaging): three head-to-tail cyclic pentapeptides; each Lys side chain bonds one arm of the 3-arm THA linker (polytool-lib). Every Lys carries two bonds (R2 ring closure + R3 to the hub), THA three.

name: bicyclic_PK15_THA
notes: PK15-like bicyclic peptide (Heinis 2009 kallikrein inhibitor ACSDRFRNCPADEALCG): Cys2, Cys9, Cys16 bound to a 3-arm linker; THA (trihexylamine, polytool-lib, R1-R3) stands in for TBMB.

name: angiotensin_II
notes: Angiotensin II (DRVYIHPF), 8 natural residues, no connections.

name: bivalirudin
notes: Bivalirudin (Angiomax), 20 residues, linear; dF = D-Phe.

name: cetrorelix
notes: Cetrorelix (Cetrotide), linear decapeptide with ac/am caps; four D-monomers whose names contain a dash and must be bracketed. D-3Pal is the library symbol for D-3-pyridylalanine.

name: leuprolide
notes: Leuprolide (Lupron): pyroglutamate (Pyr) N-terminus, D-Leu6, Pro9 ethylamide (NHEt).

name: triptorelin
notes: Triptorelin: GnRH with D-Trp6.

name: nafarelin
notes: Nafarelin: GnRH with D-2-naphthylalanine at 6.

name: histrelin
notes: Histrelin: D-His(1-benzyl) at 6, Pro9 ethylamide.

name: buserelin
notes: Buserelin: D-Ser(tBu) at 6, Pro9 ethylamide.

name: goserelin_like
notes: Goserelin-like: D-Ser(tBu) at 6; Gly-NH2 stands in for the C-terminal azaglycinamide.

name: ganirelix
notes: Ganirelix: six non-natural residues, among them D- and L-homoarginine(Et2); the L one is named L-hArg(Et,Et), whose (Et,Et) is part of the name, not a bond mark.

name: abarelix
notes: Abarelix: N-methyl-Tyr, D-Asn, N-epsilon-isopropyl-Lys.

name: icatibant_like
notes: Icatibant-like bradykinin antagonist: D-Arg, Hyp, D-Tic and octahydroindole-2-carboxylic acid (Oic). The library's Thi (3-thienylalanine) stands in for 2-thienylalanine.

name: afamelanotide
notes: Afamelanotide: [Nle4, D-Phe7]-alpha-MSH.

name: abaloparatide
notes: Abaloparatide (Tymlos), 34 aa: an Aib at 29.

name: taspoglutide
notes: Taspoglutide: [Aib8, Aib35]-GLP-1(7-36) amide.

name: lixisenatide
notes: Lixisenatide: exendin-4 without Pro38, then six Lys and an amide; 44 aa.

name: enfuvirtide
notes: Enfuvirtide (Fuzeon), 36 aa with acetyl and amide caps.

name: thymalfasin
notes: Thymalfasin (thymosin alpha 1), 28 aa, N-acetyl.

name: alamethicin_F30
notes: Alamethicin F30, a peptaibol: eight Aib and a C-terminal phenylalaninol (Phe-ol).

name: CCK-8_sulfated
notes: Cholecystokinin-8 with sulfotyrosine at 2 (the first D is Asp).

name: hirudin_54-65_sulfated
notes: Hirudin 54-65 with sulfo-Tyr63.

name: kemptide_phospho
notes: Kemptide phosphorylated by PKA: phospho-Ser5.

name: Src_SH2_ligand_pYEEI
notes: The pYEEI Src SH2 ligand: phospho-Tyr4.

name: histone_H3_K4me3_K9ac
notes: Histone H3 1-15 with trimethyl-Lys4 and acetyl-Lys9.

name: DADLE
notes: [D-Ala2, D-Leu5]-enkephalin.

name: elamipretide
notes: Elamipretide (SS-31): D-Arg, 2,6-dimethyltyrosine (Dmt).

name: leupeptin
notes: Leupeptin: Ac-Leu-Leu-argininal, a C-terminal aldehyde.

name: MG-132
notes: MG-132: Cbz-Leu-Leu-leucinal, a proteasome inhibitor.

name: Ac-DEVD-CHO
notes: Ac-DEVD-CHO: the caspase-3 inhibitor, aspartal at the C-terminus.

name: pepstatin_like
notes: Pepstatin-like: two statines (Sta). deamino-Leu (4-methylpentanoyl) stands in for the isovaleryl cap.

name: KLAKLAK2_all-D
notes: D-(KLAKLAK)2, the all-D pro-apoptotic peptide.

name: octa-D-arginine
notes: Octa-D-arginine (r8), a cell-penetrating peptide.

name: TRH
notes: Thyrotropin-releasing hormone: pGlu-His-Pro-NH2.

name: glutathione
notes: Glutathione: gamma-Glu-Cys-Gly; gGlu continues the chain through its gamma-carbonyl (R2).

name: PNA_decamer_Lys
notes: A peptide nucleic acid decamer with a C-terminal Lys amide; PNA units (pnA, pnC, pnG, pnT) are PEPTIDE monomers in the library.

name: linear_long_control
notes: No connections: label widths only. 20-char N-cap deamino-Gly_thien2yl, 19/22-char residues, bracketed dashed names [Phe_ab-dehydro_3NO2] [Oic_3axi-7axi] [D-2Nal] [Thr-ol]; Tyr_26diMe and Phe_4Sdihydroorotamido have no dash and are written without brackets.

name: disulfide_spans_long
notes: D-Pen2-D-Pen6 disulfide (R3-R3, both thiols) enclosing 19-, 16- and 22-char residues; 18-char N-cap deamino-Phg_35diMe and am C-cap. [D-Pen] is used twice in the chain (both bracketed).

name: head_to_tail_long_both_ends
notes: Cyclic octapeptide: Phe_ab-dehydro_3NO2 (19) R1 amine to Tyr_ab-dehydroMe (16) R2 carbonyl; one-letter residues alternate with dashed names.

name: head_to_tail_long_start_only
notes: Cyclic heptapeptide written as Phe_4Sdihydroorotamido(1,1)-...-V(1,2): the 22-char ring start carries its mark without brackets; the ring ends on a one-letter Val.

name: lasso_long_N_terminus
notes: Lasso (after microcin J25): N-terminal Tyr_ab-dehydroMe R1 amine to the Glu8 side-chain carboxyl (R3); a 6-residue tail with D-Phe_4ureido follows the ring.

name: lariat_long_C_terminus
notes: Lariat (after polymyxin B): [D-Dab]5 side-chain amine (R3) to the C-terminal Tyr_ab-dehydroMe carbonyl (R2); Bua acyl N-cap; unbracketed Dab and bracketed [D-Dab] in one chain.

name: thiolactone_two_dash_C_terminus
notes: Thiolactone (after the staphylococcal autoinducing peptides): Cys4 thiol (R3) to the C-terminal [D-Met_S-O] carbonyl (R2). D-Met_S-O has two dashes inside its brackets.

name: nested_three_long
notes: Three nested bonds: head-to-tail 1-9 (Phe_ab-dehydro_3NO2 R1 to D-Phe_4ureido R2), D-Pen2-D-Pen8 disulfide, D-Orn4 (delta-amine R3) to D-gGlu6 (alpha-carboxyl R3) lactam. No one-letter monomer.

name: crossing_three_long
notes: Tyr_ab-dehydroMe R1 to Glu4 R3 (1-4) crosses the D-Pen2-D-Pen7 disulfide, which crosses the D-Orn5-D-gGlu9 lactam; C-terminal [D-Thr-ol] has two dashes.

name: long_monomer_two_bonds
notes: Tyr_ab-dehydroMe as a one-monomer chain stapling Glu3 and Lys7 (i, i+4): its R1 amine to the Glu side-chain carboxyl, its R2 carbonyl to the Lys side-chain amine. Written [Tyr_ab-dehydroMe](1,1)(2,2).

name: dashed_monomer_two_bonds
notes: [D-Orn](1,1)(2,3): R1 closes the head-to-tail ring with the C-terminal Tyr_ab-dehydroMe R2, R3 (delta-amine) forms a lactam with Asp4 R3.

name: branch_chain_long_on_Lys
notes: Branch chain deamino-Gly_thien2yl-Phe_ab-dehydro_3NO2-Abu_23dehydro-Tyr_ab-dehydroMe (every monomer 13+ chars) acylates Lys4: branch R2 carbonyl to Lys R3 amine (after the lipidated Lys of semaglutide).

name: two_chains_interchain_long
notes: A macrocycle written as two chains: chain-1 start (R1) to chain-2 end (R2), chain-1 end (R2) to chain-2 start (R1), plus an inter-chain Cys4-Cys3 disulfide. The four ring-closure ends are 13-22 chars.

name: THA_hub_three_long
notes: Trivalent RGD (after RGD multimers on a tripodal core): each THA arm (CH2, H cap) N-alkylates the N-terminal amine (R1) of a chain that starts with Phe_ab-dehydro_3NO2, Tyr_ab-dehydroMe or Phe_4Sdihydroorotamido.

name: very_long_48_bonds_both_ends
notes: Head-to-tail 1-48 (Phe_ab-dehydro_3NO2 R1 to Tyr_ab-dehydroMe R2); near the start D-Dab2-Asp5 lactam crosses Cys3-Cys7; near the end D-Orn42-Glu45 lactam crosses Cys43-Cys47. 15 of the 48 names have 8+ chars, 18 are longer than 4.

name: very_long_64_long_range
notes: Near the start: Tyr_ab-dehydroMe R1 to Glu9 R3 (lasso) around the D-Pen2-D-Pen6 disulfide. Near the end: Lys56 R3 to the C-terminal Phe_ab-dehydro R2 (lariat) around the D-Orn58-D-gGlu62 lactam. Cys4-Cys61 crosses both groups. 28 of the 64 names have 8+ chars, 35 are longer than 4.

name: all_long_head_to_tail
notes: Eight monomers of 10-22 chars; ring closure Phe_ab-dehydro_3NO2 R1 to Tyr_26diMe R2.

name: all_long_three_chain_ring
notes: A cyclic 9-mer written as three chains joined end (R2) to start (R1); the third bond wraps from the end of chain 3 back to the start of chain 1. All six bond ends are long monomers.

name: all_dashed_R3_nested
notes: All nine labels shorten to the same "D…" at max monomer length 4. D-Pen1-D-Pen8 disulfide contains the D-Orn3-D-gGlu6 lactam; [D-Thr-ol] C-cap.

name: paren_comma_name_ring
notes: [L-hArg(Et,Et)](1,1) starts a head-to-tail ring that ends on Tyr_ab-dehydroMe and contains a Cys4-Cys7 disulfide. The (Et,Et) inside the name must not be read as a bond mark.

name: long_caps_both_termini
notes: Oxytocin-like D-Pen2-D-Pen7 ring between a 17-char N-terminal acyl (deamino-Gly_cPent) and an 11-char C-terminal deamino-Dab (4-aminobutanoic acid).

name: single_cap_branch_chains
notes: Lys2 and Lys4 each acylated (R3 amine to cap R2) by a one-monomer chain: deamino-Gly_thien2yl (20) and deamino-Phg_35diMe (18).
